name: Find member by last name
description: Looks up a member by last name in MERIDIAN CORE. Returns the single matching member's number and name; reports MULTIPLE_MATCHES if the search is not unique.

inputParams.name: lastName
inputParams.description: Member surname, or part of it, to search for.

outputs.name: memberId
outputs.description: Extract the member number from the member record page

outputs.name: memberName
outputs.description: Extract the member's full name from the member record page
